sources.title: LLaVA: Large Language and Vision Assistant - Microsoft Research
sources.snippet: LLaVA is an open-source project, collaborating with research community to advance the state-of-the-art in AI. LLaVA represents the first end-to-end trained large multimodal model (LMM) that achieves impressive chat capabilities mimicking spirits of the multimodal GPT-4.
